notes: #10 is Bacler d’Albe’s lithograph (Engelmann), numbered in his Souvenirs pittoresques series, published about 1818–24; Commons gives 1824 from the uploader, hence ‘about 1820’. #17 is the optional second P4 (single landmark church); drop it if only general views are wanted for that slot. P1 alternative: #4 Wyngaerde drawing 1563 (general view, low resolution). P3 alternatives: #11 Westall distant view (London, J. Murray, 1820s), #9 Laborde distant view. Event views of the 1808–09 sieges (#12 Santa Engracia ruins, #21 Calle del Coso) not used. #19 albumen photo is dated only ‘before 1880’. #23 is from a 1925 magazine; the photo itself may be a few years older. #25 (La Seo, same magazine) is an alternative for P5. A modern photo of the Pilar and the Ebro is needed for P6.
